payload.rationale: The document is a single-sentence test memory authored by Tanya (staging) verifying that an omitted git ref triggers automatic topic-branch creation. I expanded Actor_Tanya_Staging and Narrative_DefaultRefTopicBranch because they hold the 15 prior daily expressions of this exact test (Aug 31 – Sep 12, 2026), giving the passes the full lineage to place this Sep 13 entry as the next iteration. I also expanded Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint (context preservation is the next-sprint focus this test supports), Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat (product positioning context), and Position_Sprint4ThesisProven (the thesis that zero-effort capture works — this test validates part of that pipeline). I deliberately did not expand pricing, target-market, or webhook-architecture positions surfaced as tickles because this test memory does not bear on pricing, market sizing, or integration architecture.
